title: Webinar: how to avoid running the same experiment twice
summary: Join Russell Loube and Abla Alami on November 19 to explore AI, behavioural data, experimentation culture, and new Mixpanel experiment tools.
body_markdown:
Hey everyone


👋


Somewhere in your company, someone is about to run a test that a colleague already ran last year. It happens because nobody can find what’s been tested, and a failed test gets filed as a dead end instead of the quickest route to the next idea. Russell Loube (Senior PM, Experiments) and Abla Alami (Partner Customer Engineer) will talk about how that problem has shaped what we’ve built, live on


Thursday 19 November at 3pm GMT


. The webinar will also cover:


🧪


How AI has shifted the bottleneck from the cost of building to the cost of thinking


🧪


Using behavioural data and Session Replay alongside a test to find out why it won or lost


🧪


What a good experimentation culture looks like, and what knowledge people still need versus what AI can handle


🧪


What Mixpanel has shipped since April, including Web Experiments, unveiled at MXP Amsterdam It’s a fireside chat followed by live Q&A. Bring the experiment you wish you’d never run twice.
